dog.description_text:
🐶 8–10 weeks old
🐾 Potential Chihuahua Mix
💕 Small in size, BIG on personality!
I'm a happy little guy who's loving life and ready for some fun! I'm good with kids and other dogs, and I can't wait to find a family to call my own!
I'm still working on that whole potty-training thing. Hey, I'm just a baby! Give me a little patience, some encouragement, and lots of love, and I'll keep learning! 🥰
dog.name: Greg
